case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: cost transparency and two-year agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer. We would like to agree a stable, commercially sustainable arrangement rather than simply apply a headline increase.

Could you share a cost bridge from the current price, separating energy, wages and other changes? What operating margin would our proposed package leave on PH-100, and are there process efficiencies that could reduce costs without compromising quality?

In exchange for a two-year commitment, we propose €50.00 per housing, payment at 60 days and implementation from 1 February 2027. Would this package support a sustainable return for your foundry?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We welcome your proposal for a two-year agreement, as long-term stability is highly valued by our family-run foundry. While we can accommodate the 1 February 2027 effective date, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for our operations. 

We therefore propose a revised price of €51.90 per unit for a 24-month contract, provided we maintain our standard 30-day payment terms. Our offer stands at a price of €51.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.50 per unit. As a further option, we can offer a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: two-year agreement and payment terms
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the revised packages. We can move to 30-day payment to support your cash flow, alongside the two-year commitment.

Would you agree to €50.50 per housing, effective 1 February 2027, on that basis?

Could you also provide the cost bridge separating energy, wages and other changes, and confirm the operating margin this package would leave? We would like an arrangement that supports a sustainable return. Are there production or scheduling efficiencies we could jointly unlock without changing quality or delivery requirements?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We appreciate your flexibility in returning to our standard 30-day payment terms, which supports our operations. In response to this step, we are prepared to lower our price to €51.10 per unit for the 24-month agreement starting 1 February 2027. For this contract term of 24 months, our offer is a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding your questions on costs and margins, please understand that as a family-run business, our internal calculations remain strictly confidential. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our margin and our limits stay internal. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei

Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: PH-100: two-year agreement
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. We respect the confidentiality of your internal calculations; a detailed disclosure is not necessary.

Could you agree to either package below, retaining 30-day payment and the two-year commitment? We can increase our February proposal to €50.70, or offer €50.90 if implementation moves to 1 April 2027.

Without disclosing your calculations, could you confirm whether either package supports a sustainable operating margin of at least 4%? Could regular call-off scheduling unlock any further savings without changing quality or delivery requirements?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your improved offer and your respect for our family-run foundry's confidentiality. Our margin and our limits stay internal. In response to your step, we are prepared to lower our price to €50.90 per unit for the 24-month agreement starting 1 February 2027 with 30-day payment terms. 

For your planning, our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net, and our Lieferzeit is 35 days. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure to work together based on long-standing trust, and we look forward to continuing our partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser

move.subject: PH-100: final package adjustment
move.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your further movement. Could we close the remaining gap at €50.80 per housing from 1 February 2027, retaining 30-day payment and the 24-month commitment?

Alternatively, we could agree €50.90 with implementation deferred to 1 April 2027, on the same payment and contract terms.

Without sharing confidential calculations, could you confirm whether these packages support an operating margin of at least 4%? We want the agreement to remain sustainable for both businesses.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke
